name: zero-day
about: §4R L2: a fold with a zero — one campaign spent nothing and showed nowhere, another spent with no lead, so neither has a cost per lead.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 2 campaigns ran spending $42.10 total across 2,300 impressions and 19 clicks, but neither produced any leads.
points: All activity came from Dedicated night runs, which delivered 2,300 impressions, 19 clicks, and a 0.8% click rate on $42.10 in spend — no leads yet, so no cost per lead.
Regional Class A — Joliet served no impressions and recorded no clicks or spend, so it was effectively dark on the day.
Month-to-date for 2026-11, all $42.10 in spend has run through Meta with 28 days still remaining in the month.
The 2026-09-21 cohort brought in 38 leads: 33 contacted (86.8%), 17 qualified (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 hired (10.5%), and 8 lost (21.1%).
The 2026-09-28 cohort brought in 40 leads: 36 contacted (90.0%), 20 qualified (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 hired (12.5%), and 9 lost (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads so far — 9 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, and 1 lost — but it is too young to judge rates.
